workflows.dek: Four free swaps Abhijith N Arjunan replaces Lightroom with Darktable, Premiere Pro with DaVinci Resolve, Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign with the Affinity suite behind a free Canva account, and Acrobat with PDFgear, while granting that Darktable has a steep learning curve and PDFgear's OCR accuracy may not match Adobe's.
needs: Darktable, free on Win, Mac, Linux
A free Canva account for Affinity
PDFgear, free on desktop and mobile

workflows.title: Swap the all-purpose chatbot for four AI tools each built to do one job
workflows.dek: Sources, not memory Sydney Butler starts with Gemini Notebook, which works from the PDFs, web pages, documents, and videos you hand it and can read them back as a podcast-style audio overview, then adds Perplexity for cited search, Midjourney for images, and ElevenLabs for voice, and he warns that the notebook still hallucinates occasionally.
needs: Your own PDFs, links, or documents

workflows.title: Give the old Android tablet in the drawer a job again with five free apps
workflows.dek: Five lightweight apps Goran Damnjanovic turns a slow tablet into a reader with Librera, a stylus notepad with Squid, a video player with NOVA, a Pomodoro timer with Goodtime, and an RSS reader with FeedMe, all free and running on hardware as old as Android 8.0, though he sends you to F-Droid for Librera's fully open-source build and to VLC on truly ancient devices.
needs: An old Android tablet, 8.0 or newer

workflows.title: Add Android Auto to a car that never had it, using a spare Android device
workflows.dek: Headunit Revived is an open-source Android Auto receiver that Tashreef Shareef walked through with a setup wizard, running on anything from Android 4.1 upward, free as an APK from GitHub or $3.99 on Google Play for automatic updates, though he says it is not a perfect replacement for factory Android Auto and that devices with less RAM or weaker processors may struggle.
needs: A spare tablet or head unit
The free APK, or $3.99 on Play

workflows.title: Type every line of AI-written code yourself, and keep what you learn
workflows.dek: Chat, then type Ankur Sethi tells his assistant to show every proposed edit in the chat instead of touching project files, retypes each line into the editor himself, and runs commands by hand; he calls the habit grossly inefficient and reckons it leaves him about 2x faster rather than the 10x that freer use of agents promises.
needs: A chat window, not a file agent

workflows.title: Print, cut, and fold a paper globe from 30 free templates
workflows.dek: Thirty curated globes print at A4 or A3 with no signup and no watermark, covering planets, moons, Earth from space and data globes, while custom globes with pinned locations and highlighted countries are a separate one-time purchase starting at $6.95.
needs: A home printer, A4 or A3 paper

workflows.title: Shrink an hour of video from 6.46GB to 2.29GB on Windows, for free
workflows.dek: Constant quality H.264 in an MP4 container took Oluwademilade Afolabi's 1080p file from 6.46GB to 2.29GB in roughly two and a half hours with VidCoder, and he notes fine detail looked slightly softer in fast-moving scenes, so he previews the result and keeps the original.
needs: The original file, kept as backup

workflows.title: Put the files you keep remaking into the Windows right-click New menu
workflows.dek: No registry editing required: Afam Onyimadu turns on the New+ module under File Management in Microsoft PowerToys, then drops template files into its folder so they appear on right-click, and he advises adding only the kinds of file you genuinely keep recreating.
needs: Two or three files you keep remaking

workflows.title: Print five car accessories tonight instead of ordering them
workflows.dek: Half an hour for the visor clip and an hour or two for the air vent phone mount, from MakerWorld models the guide links, with a warning worth heeding: plain PLA starts to deform at around 50C (122F), so a parked car calls for PETG, ASA, ABS or PET instead.
needs: PETG, ASA, ABS or PET filament

workflows.title: Back up one folder to every cloud account you own, with a single command
workflows.dek: One union remote Faisal Rasool's Saturday walkthrough installs rclone, authenticates each account with rclone config, then merges Google Drive, Dropbox and the rest into one union remote so a single copy command fans a folder out to all of them.
needs: rclone, free on Windows, Mac, Linux
